title: Longest Zigzag Subsequence
statement:
Find the longest subsequence whose comparisons alternate direction.

Contract
- `numbers` is non-null and may be empty. Values may repeat.
- Return the maximum length of a subsequence where successive differences strictly alternate between positive and negative.
- Equal neighbouring chosen values do not create either direction and should not extend the zigzag. Do not mutate `numbers`.

Examples
- `longestZigZag(new int[]{1, 7, 4, 9, 2, 5})` returns `6`.
- `longestZigZag(new int[]{1, 1, 1})` returns `1`.
hints: Only the sign of the latest non-zero difference matters.
Keep two lengths: one ending with an upward move and one ending with a downward move.
When the next difference is positive, extend the best downward-ending subsequence, and vice versa.
